        WHEN frpm.FRPM_Count_K_12 >= 0.5 AND frpm.FRPM_Count_K_12 < 0.6 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS FRPM_Level,

    s.Percent_Eligible_Free_K_12 AS Free_Meal_Eligibility_Rate,
